result.instructions: PhotoCraft image editor. Start with doc_new/doc_open, discover ids and parameter docs with command_list, edit with command_run or command_batch (one history step per command). Inspect with doc_inspect and render_preview; doc_save writes native .pcraft or exports by extension. File paths are relative to the read/write roots granted at launch. ui_inspect/ui_screenshot and other ui_* tools require bridge mode. Read photocraft://document and photocraft://commands for live JSON state.
